d: It’s Nobel Prize season here on Curiosity Weekly, and we are ready to break down the science behind this year’s winners! This episode, host Dr. Samantha Yammine digs into what research received the prize for medicine and physiology, physics, and chemistry. Joining her is neuroscientist and pain specialist Dr. Lindsay Ejoh. Together, they discuss how optogenetics has shifted how we study the brain and why it was so deserving of this year’s award.
